# --- Rule 1: Alt-History Scale ---
oe_v49_is_alt_ai_unleashed = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }
			has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_alt_romantic_unleashed
		}
	}
}

	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }
			has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_alt_strict_historical
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_is_alt_balanced = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only }

		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }

		}
	}
}

# --- Rule 3: Endgame Crisis & Boss ---
oe_v49_is_endgame_boss_active = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }
			OR = {
				has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_armada
				has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_global_coalition
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_is_endgame_boss_off = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }
			has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_off
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_is_endgame_coalition_active = {
	oe_v49_is_endgame_boss_active = yes
	has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_global_coalition
}
